english.title: Disclose information concerning an undertaking in the white fish industry without consent
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) disclosed information, namely **(..SPECIFY INFORMATION..), with respect to an undertaking, namely **(..SPECIFY UNDERTAKING..), which had been obtained under or by virtue of Part 1 of the Sea Fish Industry Act 1970 otherwise than in connection with the execution of that Part or a scheme or regulations under that Part, without the consent of the person carrying on that undertaking
english.legislation: Contrary to section 14 of the Sea Fish Industry Act 1970.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: See further section 14(1) and (2) of the Sea Fish Industry Act 1970.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
NoneOn the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
